poses.label: Top
poses.description: Hold the bar above your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower the bar with your elbows close to your sides.

poses.label: Chest
poses.description: Touch your lower chest, elbows tucked near your ribs.

poses.label: Press
poses.description: Press back up without lifting your shoulders.

review.checked_by: Claude, renderer fixture for straight-bar grips (#262)
checks: Shoulder-width overhand grip, narrower than the standard bench grip, with the elbows near the ribs.
Both hands stay on their grip points on the bar at every pose and between poses.
limitations: Renderer fixture only. Final poses are authored and reviewed separately.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
